data.body_html:
Marbella Pride 2040 is set to be the most vibrant celebration on the Costa del Sol, and what better way to join the festivities than with a luxury boat party from Puerto Banus? Whether you’re flying the rainbow flag with friends or family, our fleet of 17 yachts offers the perfect setting for an unforgettable day on the Mediterranean. From the sleek Astondoa 40 at €749 for 2 hours to the majestic Mangusta 80 with a free jet ski, every charter includes a skipper, drinks, snacks, and all taxes. Book now to secure your spot for Pride 2040.

Why Choose a Boat Party for Marbella Pride 2040?

Marbella Pride is a week-long explosion of colour, music, and inclusivity. A private boat charter lets you escape the crowded beaches and enjoy the celebration from the water. Cruise along the Golden Mile, anchor at Cala del Faro, and dance with the iconic La Concha mountain as your backdrop. With no queues, no noise limits, and your own bar, it’s the ultimate Pride experience. Plus, all our boats depart from Puerto Banus, the heart of Marbella’s glamour.

Our Fleet for Pride Boat Parties

We offer a diverse range of boats to suit any Pride group. For up to 12 guests, the Mangusta 80 (24m) or Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m) provide ample deck space and luxury. The Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) is perfect for intimate parties, while the Ferretti 94 (29m) offers the ultimate VIP experience. All boats are fully equipped with sound systems, sun pads, and shaded areas.

  • Astondoa 40 – 12.5m, 9 pax, from €749/2h
  • Azimut 39 – 12.5m, 11 pax, from €749/2h
  • Mangusta 80 – 24m, 12 pax, from €4,719/4h (free jet ski)
  • Azimut 58 Flybridge – 17.6m, 12 pax
  • Ferretti 94 – 29m, 12 pax

For smaller groups, the Dubhe (8m, 5 pax) or Speedboat (7m, 6 pax) are affordable options. All charters include a licensed skipper, fuel, insurance, and Spanish IVA.

Pricing and Inclusions for Pride Charters

Our transparent pricing ensures no surprises. Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39) cost €749 for 2 hours, €1,149 for 4 hours, and €2,299 for 8 hours. The Mangusta 80 (Tier B) is €4,719 for a minimum of 4 hours, which includes a free jet ski for extra fun. All other boats are priced on request via WhatsApp. Every charter includes water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, and full insurance. Just bring your Pride gear and a smile.

Best Itineraries for a Pride Boat Party

Departing from Puerto Banus, you can cruise to iconic spots like Cabopino beach, Cala Cortés, or Estepona. For a longer trip, head to Sotogrande. Our skippers know the best anchorages for swimming, photos, and partying. The calm Mediterranean waters in June make for smooth sailing. You can also stay close to Marbella Marina for a quick dip near the Golden Mile. Custom itineraries are available—just ask via WhatsApp.

How to Book Your Marbella Pride 2040 Boat Party

Booking is easy. Browse our fleet, choose your boat, and contact us via WhatsApp for availability. We recommend reserving early as Pride dates are popular. Payment is secure, and our team will confirm your charter with all details. For groups larger than 12, we can arrange multiple boats. Celebrate Pride 2040 in style—on the water with us.

Frequently asked questions

What is included in a Marbella Pride 2040 boat party?

Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, insurance, safety equipment, Spanish IVA (21%), water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, and light snacks. You just bring your Pride spirit and guests.

Which boats are best for a Pride boat party in Puerto Banus?

For groups up to 12, the Mangusta 80 (24m) or Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m) offer ample deck space. The Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) is ideal for smaller parties. All depart from Puerto Banus.

How much does a Pride boat party cost in Marbella?

Tier A boats like the Astondoa 40 start at €749 for 2 hours and go up to €2,299 for 8 hours. The Mangusta 80 (Tier B) costs €4,719 minimum for 4 hours, including a free jet ski. Other boats are priced on request via WhatsApp.

Can I bring my own decorations for Pride?

Yes, you are welcome to bring Pride flags, banners, and decorations. Please ensure they are securely attached and do not damage the boat. Our crew can assist with setup.

Most of our boats accommodate up to 12 guests, including the Mangusta 80, Azimut 58, and Ferretti 94. The Astondoa 40 takes 9 guests, and the Dubhe (8m) takes 5. Check the fleet for exact capacities.

How do I book a boat for Marbella Pride 2040?

You can book directly through our website or contact us via WhatsApp for custom requests. We recommend booking early as Pride dates fill quickly. All charters depart from Puerto Banus.

Marbella enjoys Mediterranean summers with average temperatures of 28-32°C in June. Sea conditions are typically calm, making it perfect for boat parties. We monitor weather and may reschedule for safety.
